models_evaluated: object detection-based deep learning guidance algorithm for AAA POCUS

links.outcome: Scan quality of DL-guided novice nurses versus physicians without DL guidance
links.effect: DL-guided novices achieved adequate scan quality in 87.5% (95% CI 82.7-92.3%) of patients, comparable to 91.3% (87.2-95.4%) for physicians (p=0.310).
links.quote: The DL-guided novices achieved adequate scan quality in 87.5% (95% CI: 82.7 - 92.3%) of patients, comparable to the 91.3% (95% CI: 87.2-95.4%) rate of physician scans (p=0.310).

unlisted_practices: Real-time AI guidance enabling novice non-specialist users to acquire diagnostic-quality ultrasound images

screen.reason: Prospective clinical trial evaluating the performance and feasibility of a real-time deep learning guidance tool for novice nurse users performing point-of-care ultrasound for AAA screening on real patients.
